actions.cancel-subscription.description: Cancels a Paddle subscription immediately or at the next billing period.
actions.cancel-subscription.props.effect: Choose when Paddle should apply the cancellation.
actions.cancel-subscription.props.subscr: Select the Paddle subscription to use.
actions.create-transaction.description: Creates a Paddle transaction. When you use recurring prices, completing the transaction starts the subscription.
actions.create-transaction.props.address: Select the Paddle address to bill against.
actions.create-transaction.props.customD: Optional JSON object to store on the transaction.
actions.create-transaction.props.custome: Select the Paddle customer to use.
actions.create-transaction.props.priceId: Select an active recurring Paddle price.
actions.create-transaction.props.quantit: Optional quantity for the recurring price.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get-subscription.description: Retrieves a Paddle subscription by ID.
actions.get-subscription.props.subscript: Select the Paddle subscription to use.
actions.list-customers.description: Lists customers from your Paddle account.
actions.list-customers.props.email.descr: Optionally filter customers by exact email address.
actions.list-customers.props.limit.descr: Maximum number of customers to return.
actions.update-subscription.description: Updates a Paddle subscription. Send the full recurring item list you want the subscription to keep.
actions.update-subscription.props.custom: Optional JSON object to store on the subscription.
actions.update-subscription.props.priceI: Select an active recurring Paddle price.
actions.update-subscription.props.prorat: How Paddle should bill for the subscription change.
actions.update-subscription.props.quanti: Optional quantity for the recurring price.
actions.update-subscription.props.subscr: Select the Paddle subscription to use.
auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.
description: Manage customers, subscriptions, and recurring billing with Paddle Billing.
triggers.newActiveSubscription.descripti: Triggers when a subscription activates — a trial converts or the first payment succeeds.
triggers.paymentFailed.description: Triggers when a transaction payment fails — trigger retry logic or alert the customer.
triggers.subscriptionCanceled.descriptio: Triggers when a subscription is canceled — revoke access or notify support.
triggers.subscriptionPastDue.description: Triggers when a subscription goes past due — start dunning flows or restrict features.
triggers.transactionCompleted.descriptio: Triggers when a transaction completes successfully — send a receipt or update records.
